finding.required_interpretation: If run fails, inspect precise exception point and parameter finiteness before calling this checkpoint safe. Preserve previous checkpoint if changing code later.
finding.detail: Broad except writes current model to checkpoint-last-safe even if complete_update failed after scaler.step, such as a poststep nonfinite parameter assertion. This could overwrite a previously known-safe checkpoint.

autocast_hypothesis.comparison_rule: Use identical wrapper arithmetic for baseline and adapted evaluation and revalidate finite updates/reload.
autocast_hypothesis.possible_bounded_experiment: Wrap the existing PyTorch chunk DeltaNet function call in torch.autocast(cuda,enabled=False), preserving internal conversion and output dtype. Do not change unknown kernels or underlying installed code.
autocast_hypothesis.evidence: Installed Torch2.8 autocast policy downcasts matmul/mm/bmm. DeltaNet explicitly casts inputs to FP32 but executes eligible @ operations inside outer FP16 autocast; later FP32 multiplication does not restore lost precision.
autocast_hypothesis.limits: FP16 input/output boundary gradients and other model operations may still overflow; extra FP32 compute memory/time must be guarded.

scale_bound_note: PyTorch allows GradScaler scales below1; min1 is this experiment limit, not a general feasibility theorem.
